I am—
going to become a Derby Umamusume, you hear meeeeee!!

Also, if Hayahide is here, that means,
ummmmmmm...

(Is it because we've been together the whole time and you taught me so much...?
Is it because I've been talking a ton with Trainer every single day...?)

You know... I've never once run a race
that could show everyone in the crowd a real dream.

Ghhkk~~! Thank youuuu so much!!
I'll do my absolute best~~!!

Ah, there you are!! Taishiiiiiiiiin!!
Come over heeeeere!!

Winning Ticket accelerates here!!
She's pulling away from the pack further and further!!

Gaaah, don't yell my name at the top of your lungs, you idiot!!
Everyone around us is staring now...!,

To have such a wonderful trainer by my side,
I'm... I'b so... *sob*!!

Ahaha, sorry, sorry! But I'm just so glad to see you two!!
Hayahide's race is in the afternoon, so I didn't think you'd be here this morning!

But you know, you know! After meeting Trainer,
training together, and learning so much, right now... right now...!
Uryaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

Here comes Ticket!! Ticket makes her move!!
What a tremendous final spurt!!

...I was just passing by on a walk.
It's noisy, there's an annoyance here, so I'm heading back.
(WAAAAAHHHH!!)

And they're off in the 1700m Turf race! What kind of race
will these future star umamusume candidates show us today!?

Ehehe, yeah!!
Because I've got Trainer right by my side!

—The final stretch!! This is it, right!?
Full power, GOOOOOOOOO!!

Yeah, that's the oooone!!
Wait, Hayahide! Good morning!!

Good morning. You're quite enthusiastic, Ticket.
It is reassuring to see you free of tension and ready to give your all.
Aaaah! Taishiiiiiiiiin!!

Taking the lead is Winning Ticket!
A powerful, yet remarkably composed run!

Ticket! Congrats!!
That was a great run!!

(Huh...? Wait, huh...!?
What is this... it feels so strange...!!)

Unlike back at the Debut selection race—
not a single soul doubted those words now.

So right here, right now, I swear to all of you... and to
my Trainer, who taught me how to run!!

Today is the day of the Event-by-Event Sports Meet,
where students are free to enter any event they choose.

What was that phrase again...?
Co... com... compo...?

Uwahhh, thank you, thank you sooo much!!
I am the happiest girl in the wooorld!

A lot of girls who've already debuted are in the 1700m Turf
event that I entered, but...

I'll do my best, so stay and watch my race!
Don't say such lonely stuff! Uwaaaah!

Ghhhhhhh, I can't waaaait!!
I wanna go run right noooow!!
(WAAAAAHHH...!!)

So, why is Taishin... wait, huh?
Didn't you say you don't care about school events and were gonna skip?

Of course! It's a great chance to show everyone
the results of our training together, after all!!

Impressive...! Heh,
you found yourself quite a good trainer, Ticket!
Yeah, I wanted to see your race too.

......No no no!!
Before I start crying, there's something I need to say!!

Nnnghaaaaahhhhh!!
The words won't come ooooouuut!!

No waaaay!?
Taishin... are you going home...?

(“Stay calm and watch your surroundings,” “Pace yourself,”
“Run your own race”... It's like I can hear the Trainer's voice.)

Oh, that's right, Trainer, let me introduce you! Hayahide is my
classmate!! She's super, crazy smart!!

As usual, many visitors have come to the academy, filling the campus with a sudden hustle and bustle.
Yet, raising her voice to overpower even that clamor is—

Traaaiiineeeerrrr!!
It's finally my turn to ruuuun!!
Ugh, geez, don't cry right away, you're so annoying...!
Sorry! I'll... say the rest with my racing!!

...Anyway, I'm going.
See ya.

Wait, really!? T... Ta... Taishiiiin!
Your clumsy friendship touches my heaaart!!

To pay you back... one day, I'll definitely become
an Umamusume who can give dreams to everyone!!

...Worry not, Ticket.
Taishin walked toward the spectator stands.
Consider it a preliminary bout.
(I get it... I hear you loud and clear, Trainer!)
Haah, haah, haah, haah...!!

Huh... her running style changed.
When did she learn to run like that...?
Thanks for all the cheeeeers, everyoooone!!

And across the liiiine! In 1st place is Winning Ticket!
What a spectacular victory!!
(—CLANK!!)

With that heartwarming moment behind them...
the time had finally come for Winning Ticket to race.
